purpose: test whether the repeated Villavicencio network response is estimable after conventional opportunity and compatibility filters, without inferring decision-equivalence classes

traits_and_covariates.trait_subset: 45 plant species and 135 flower-visiting species with morphological data

primary_temporal_design.unit: adjacent subseason transition within a year
primary_temporal_design.exact_source_period_name_mapping: externally_reconstructed_from documented Dryad subseason date boundaries; exact RData object identity remains unverified

response_definition.primary_stage1_quantity: changed links among species independently present in both adjacent networks
response_definition.species_turnover_component: changed links for which at least one endpoint species is not present in both adjacent networks
response_definition.network_metric_claim: operational feasibility partition, not a new additive beta-diversity metric

presence_policy.preferred: independent species presence or abundance information
presence_policy.forbidden: silently equating zero observed degree with true absence

allowed_inputs: outcome-independent temporal opportunity reconstructed from raw dated records
floral abundance or other opportunity covariates defined independently of the focal response
compatibility_policy.forbidden: renaming trait clusters as decision-equivalence classes; using the published aggregate phenological-overlap support as an independent full candidate-dyad gain surface after the support-leakage audit

decision_structure_policy.promotion_gate: only an independently measured cue-choice or decision layer may define decision-equivalence classes for Stage 2

stage1_success_gate: the 12 primary within-year transitions can be reconstructed reproducibly
shared-species opportunity is nonzero in enough primary transitions to estimate link change
species presence semantics are documented rather than inferred silently
trait and phenology covariates join without response-dependent filtering
a prespecified rewiring outcome retains estimable variation after conventional controls
stage1_failure_gate: the network and trait species identifiers cannot be crosswalked reproducibly
too few shared species remain after the trait-available subset is frozen
most apparent species turnover is inseparable from non-detection
no usable rewiring variation remains after conventional opportunity filters
claim_ceiling: Stage 1 establishes a reproducible 18-period observed-link turnover surface and resolves its sampling-effort semantics. Because binary detection remains materially effort-sensitive, it does not identify true ecological rewiring. It also cannot validate environmental routeability or decision-structural turnover without an independent decision-structure layer.

required: checksum-validated public Figshare raw visitor files

rdata_route.remaining_role: optional byte-for-byte cross-check against the published 18-network RData object if access becomes available

descriptive_quantities: transitions with both changed and unchanged eligible dyads
nondegeneracy_checks: global outcome contains both changed and unchanged eligible dyads
at least one transition has a within-transition changed-versus-unchanged contrast
response_estimability_gate.reason: power and model-identification thresholds must be frozen only after the source grain and covariate joins are verified, without inspecting decision-structure effects

source_acquisition_gate.raw_figshare_reconstruction_condition: public raw-record checksums plus externally documented subseason boundaries and an explicit missing-date audit

sampling_detection_policy.problem: apparent link gain/loss can reflect unequal observation effort or imperfect detection rather than biological rewiring
required_inventory_before_ecological_int: period-specific observation effort if recoverable from source data or methods
whether sampling sites or observation effort changed among years/subseasons
distribution of interaction weights for links classified as gains or losses
sampling_detection_policy.primary_stage1_status: observed-link turnover feasibility surface; do not identify binary gains/losses as ecological rewiring
prespecified_sensitivities_if_bytes_allo: repeat link-change audit after excluding the lowest-frequency observed links using a threshold frozen before decision-structure analysis
report weighted interaction change alongside binary link change
stratify or offset by sampling effort when a defensible effort measure exists
forbidden: interpreting every zero interaction as a true forbidden or absent link
choosing a frequency threshold after inspecting decision-structure effects

annual_detection_sensitive_fallback.limitation: observed-positive-link presence makes species-turnover partition detection-sensitive
annual_detection_sensitive_fallback.primary_design_status: retained as the annual ecological-baseline analysis; no longer the highest-resolution Stage-1 response because the 18-period raw-record response is reconstructed

conventional_filter_baseline.interpretation: Historical numerical baseline only. Its gain-filter ecological interpretation is quarantined because the published non-zero phenological-overlap support is nested inside ever-realized links. Use the focal-excluded raw-record repair as the valid ecological baseline.

filter_block_ablation.ecological_read: Historical block-ablation arithmetic only. The phenology block cannot be interpreted as an outcome-independent candidate-dyad filter because of the support-leakage audit.
filter_block_ablation.claim_ceiling: historical numerical attribution only; superseded for ecological interpretation by the support-leakage audit and focal-excluded repair

focal_excluded_opportunity_repair.interpretation: Focal-response-excluded current-year plant availability and pollinator activity carry reproducible information about annual link dynamics. One-year-lagged opportunity does not recover the same signal; pair-specific weekly overlap is only a small, sensitivity-dependent increment.
focal_excluded_opportunity_repair.claim_ceiling: retrospective current-state opportunity association only; no causality, strict forecasting, decision equivalence, or routeability

date_missingness.2011: 433 of 440 annual links date-reconstructable; 7 links occur only in undated positive rows
date_missingness.2006_2010: complete annual link support from dated positive records

raw_subseason_response_reconstruction.endpoint_model_boundary: 2006_mid->2006_late has gain=1 and loss=0; response feasibility is green, but separate endpoint-specific held-out loss modeling must use a nondegenerate prespecified scope.
raw_subseason_response_reconstruction.interpretation: The documented 18-period temporal response grain is reconstructable from public raw dated records without using routeability exposure information. Exact byte identity with the unavailable RData object is not claimed.
